value.message: Town of Oakville Learn to Swim runs Preschool A Saturdays 9:00-9:30am, Sept 12 to Nov 28, for ages 3-5 - their site says, though the fee isn't posted, just that it's set by Council in the Recreation Guide. Fall registration opens Aug 11 at 7am for residents. I could not tie a price to it and I'll keep watching and text you when it's posted.
